messages:
Leah (CS): Quick sync — pulled ~12 distinct asks from the Pinebrook pilot this week. Flagging 3 recurring pain points + 5 small feature/doc asks. Can we triage what goes to product backlog vs docs/enablement?
Jordan (PM): Thanks — can you paste the raw list here or a link? I can run it through our PRIO rubric.
Leah (CS): Link: https://rbwrd.docs/pinebrook-pilot-asks (private) — pasted below the short version.
Leah (CS): Pain A: token-cost spikes when customers use long context + embeddings together. Observed 2x cost over baseline.
Leah (CS): Pain B: onboarding wizard occasionally loses state if user navigates away -> forces re-run of large uploads.
Leah (CS): Pain C: per-route cost breakdown confusing to customers — they ask for per-feature delta not just bucketed totals.
Leah (CS): Small asks: (1) example prompt gallery for docs, (2) quick note about batching recommendations, (3) 'how to' for rollbacks in Console, (4) an FAQ blurb about caching behavior, (5) update example SDK snippet to show quantization flag.
Kai (SE): For Pain A — could be an autoscaling/batching mismatch. I saw requests with many short streaming calls + one large embed call in the same session. Suggest we add a heuristic: avoid mixing heavy embed jobs with low-latency chat in same routing bucket.
Jordan (PM): Good call. I'll add a spike mitigation card. Severity? Leah where are they on renewal?
Leah (CS): Renewal is due in 7 weeks — account health is generally good but finance flagged cost variability as the top blocker to expansion. So priority high for Cost-related fixes.
Nora (CS Lead): For triage: suggest we mark Cost spikes as P0 for roadmap alignment, Wizard state as P1 (docs + quick fix), Per-route cost UX as P1/P2 depending on effort. Small asks -> docs/enablement first.
Ravi (CS): I talked to their Dev lead — they can tolerate a temporary FYI banner about cost while we fix. That reduces immediate churn risk.
Jordan (PM): Proposed next steps:
- I will create three tickets: COST_SPIKE (investigate routing + batching), WIZARD_STATE (repro steps + quick patch), COST_UX (design mock + estimate).
- Docs team to pick up the 5 small asks as a sprint chore.
- Assign owners and target a small customer-facing note within 2 weeks.
Leah (CS): Awesome. Can we add severity tags in the sheet? Makes decisions faster.
Leah (CS): Quick vote — react with :one: for P0 COST_SPIKE, :two: for P1 but not P0, :three: if you think we deprioritize.
feedback-bot: :one: (Jordan)
Kai (SE): :one:
Nora (CS Lead): :one:
Leah (CS): :one:
Jordan (PM): Noted — consensus P0.
Jordan (PM): ETA: I'll have the three tickets up by EOD tomorrow with initial triage notes and owners.
Leah (CS): I'll prepare a short customer note template + attach example telemetry showing the spike so Finance can share with their procurement team.
Ravi (CS): I'll scope the onboarding wizard repro and add steps to the ticket.
Leah (CS): Thanks team — tagging @eng-runtime for COST_SPIKE follow-up once ticket is created.
Kai (SE): pinged eng-runtime channel. Will follow up on kernel/routing side once we have reproduction.
Nora (CS Lead): Nice — keep the doc-first approach. Please update the sheet column "Outcome" when ticket created.
Leah (CS): Will do. Closing this thread; follow-ups in the tickets. :thumbsup:
